ncvs.name: National Crime Victimization Survey (NCVS), Race and Hispanic Origin of Victims and Offenders, 2012–15 (BJS)

homicide.name: FBI Supplementary Homicide Reports via OJJDP Statistical Briefing Book / 2022 National Report

notes: Nonfatal data: NCVS 2012–15, ages 12–17, victim’s perception of offender race. Crimes: rape/sexual assault, robbery, aggravated assault, simple assault.
Homicide rates: approximate youth (under 18) victimization rates by race from FBI SHR/OJJDP (~2019). These are rates of being killed, not the race of the offender.
No published national summary provides the victim-race × offender-race cross-tab for child homicide victims.
Red ✕ indicates data that is not published in available official summaries.
More years and crime types can be added as additional published tables are located or processed.
